meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接手 NanoClaw 从 v1 升级到 v2 的收尾工作:先检查升级脚本是否运行,再设置管理员、迁移旧记忆等。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”等关键词时触发;若 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 尚未运行,Claude 会先提示你运行该脚本。

say.text: 继续 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: Claude 会先读取交接文件,再逐阶段处理。

say.text: 迁移后帮我设管理员账号
say.note: Claude 会查询用户列表并为你授予 owner 角色。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude handles the final part of a NanoClaw v1-to-v2 migration: verifies the setup script, sets up the owner, migrates old memory, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “migrate from v1”, “finish migration”, or similar phrases. If `bash migrate-v2.sh` hasn't run yet, Claude first tells you to run it in your terminal.

say_en.note: Claude reads the handoff file and starts the follow-up phases.

say_en.text: Set me as the owner after migration
say_en.note: Claude queries the users and grants the owner role.

say_en.text: Migrate my legacy memory to v2
say_en.note: Claude runs /migrate-memory for the imported groups.
